_about: Latvian public holidays used by get_slots and the works logic. Statutory days are cited from the law; anything not verified against an official source is marked assumption:true and is treated as NON-working (the safe side: Anna never offers a slot on a day the office may be closed).

law.title_lv: Par svētku, atceres un atzīmējamām dienām
law.title_en: Law on Holidays, Remembrance Days and Celebration Days
law.published: likumi.lv (official consolidated text); fixed days and Easter days re-checked against calendars published 2026-09 (2027: 252 working days, 113 non-working days = 104 weekend days + 9 weekday holidays)
law.scope: Lists the public holidays: 1 Jan; Good Friday, Easter Sunday and Easter Monday (Easter is computed in code); 1 May; 4 May; 23 and 24 Jun; 18 Nov; 24, 25, 26 and 31 Dec.

working_day_transfers.note: Cabinet orders that move a working day to a Saturday bind only state-budget institutions; other employers are only encouraged to follow. They are NOT applied here (Anna works Mon-Fri; the 2026 transfers are in the past). A holiday on Saturday or Sunday does NOT create an extra day off today (3 May 2027 and 27 Dec 2027 are working days; the older Sunday rule appears only in a 2006 amendment draft).
